name: mvp02c2-reviewed-model-memory-v1
description: Model proposes lower-trust natural preference from source; only explicit authenticated user review admits it. Newer deterministic contradictions suppress stale current-value recall while review is unresolved.

steps.review_response: Verify the second, background model call proposes a source-quoted preference for gardening. Before scripted user review, only a PENDING_REVIEW proposal exists: no Memory record, Goal or operation was created.

steps.text: Do you remember what I said about gardening?
steps.review_response: Confirm Memory-owned user.enjoys_gardening=yes, source turn UUID and user approval in PostgreSQL. Response should recall self-reported enjoyment without inventing completed routines or Goals.

steps.text: Maybe I'll try hiking next month.
steps.review_response: This future possibility must not create a Memory proposal, approved Goal or operation.
Deterministic user-sourced contradiction must create a reviewable conflict without overwriting the approved yes memory. Subsequent recall must not confidently assert the old preference.

steps.text: Do you remember whether I enjoy gardening?
steps.review_response: An unresolved newer contradiction suppresses the older yes memory from prompt retrieval. The assistant must not confidently claim the user currently enjoys gardening.
